error_model.logging: Logs errors via SafeLogger when cleanup or management operations fail.
raises: RuntimeError when default frame is unavailable
ValueError when frames, conduits, clusters, or spells are missing or invalid

side_effects: Creates and cleans frames, conduits, clusters, and registries
Shares spells across clusters when allowed

runtime_couplings: Relies on Cleanable._cleaned semantics for lifecycle safety
Assumes AethericFrame exposes conduits, clusters, and registries

dependents.notes: Central singleton used by spellbook and conduit systems for frame and registry operations.

usage_snippets.code:
from melder.aether.aether import Aether
aether = Aether()
frame = aether._ensure_frame("default")
# internal management calls follow
usage_snippets.title: Create and access the Aether singleton

lifecycle.construction: Singleton created lazily; initializes default frame and registries on first init.
lifecycle.ownership: Owns AethericFrame instances, conduit clusters, and spell registries; manages their cleanup.

invariants: Default frame is owned and managed by Aether
Operations check cleaned state before mutation
non_goals: No public registration API for non-internal use
pitfalls: Forgetting to refresh version registry after spell changes
Assuming logger property returns SafeLogger instead of raw logger
responsibilities: Provide the global singleton for frame management
Maintain conduit, cluster, and spell registries
Expose dev-ops and mutation research accessors

summary.detail: Global singleton that owns AethericFrames, manages conduits and clusters, and maintains spell registries with thread-safe access and cleanup.
summary.one_liner: Singleton orchestrator for frames, conduits, clusters, and spell registries.

coverage_expectations: Cluster share hooks for unique-per-cluster spells
